summary: ped re-skin: the like ped's skinned mesh and 32-bone skeleton stay as they are (kit export cannot write a skin, and an unskinned ped crashes the game); every item is a part of the new atlas painted for the design, proven by the texture on the faces that show it: import the like ped with the new TXD into the session and tag the faces of each region. A reviewer judges the painting.

overall.summary: the whole ped front, back, side

notes: Rename items to the real design ('Front bumper with a centre air intake'), add what the design has with keys of your own (roof rack, bull bar, side steps), split an item when a reviewer could point at its halves.
Never drop a starter item silently: delete it only with a 'waived' entry {key, why} (asset.inventory reports dropped keys; the strict check blocks them).
Tag the built geometry with scene.tag (whole objects, or faces with a select) as you build; an item counts as built only when its own geometry carries its id and touches what it attaches to.

items.name: Head and face
items.construction: the like ped's head kept as it is; the face painted on the atlas: eyes, brows, mouth and soft skin shading from the reference

items.name: Hair
items.construction: hair painted on the head's texture with soft strands and a hairline (or the like ped's hair mesh repainted)

items.name: Top garment
items.construction: the top garment painted on the torso: collar, seams, buttons, folds and the print of the design

items.name: Sleeves and arms
items.construction: sleeves (or skin) painted on the arms with cuffs and elbow folds

items.name: Hands
items.construction: hands painted with knuckle shading and nails (gloves when the design has them)

items.name: Trousers or skirt
items.construction: trousers or skirt painted on the legs: seams, belt, knee folds

items.name: Shoes
items.construction: shoes painted with soles, laces or straps and a dark gap at the sole

items.name: Garment details
items.construction: pockets, stitching, creases and labels painted where the design has them

items.name: Shading and contact shadows
items.construction: soft dark at the neck, armpits, elbows and knees baked into the atlas

items.name: Accessories
items.construction: glasses, watch, chain or bag painted where the design has them

items.name: Wear and dirt
items.construction: wear, dirt and fading that fit the character, soft

views_note: views name the close-up regions of 'blender preview --regions' (data/kit/regions/ped.json) that show each region; 'overall' with no views = the standard preview sheet
